text: Detailed execution plan lodged 2026-08-02. Fixed order: (1) close B3 with explicit work-space versus endpoint correspondence evidence, a reusable frozen-support true-neighborhood-CC evaluator shared with HalfFlowCc, and one atomic matcher to projector to assimilator to accepted-state rewarp/rematch round; prove non-identity frame semantics, support frozen within alpha search and refreshed between rounds, swap symmetry, topology, immutable rejection, and focused/full JVM plus Scala.js gates. (2) begin B4 only after B3 closes; freeze the numeric matcher, projector, assimilator, round-budget, and HalfFlow budget2x manifest before results, then run oracle-to-bridge, oracle-to-bridge-to-HalfFlow, and block-to-bridge-to-HalfFlow over deterministic 2/4/8/12 mm translation plus rotation, affine, regional, outlier, boundary, flat, repeated-pattern, and identity cases. (3) apply the predeclared decision table: fix B2/B3 if oracle assimilation fails; trigger B5 if oracle enters the basin but HalfFlow stalls; open a narrow matcher child if block lags oracle; retain the architecture if block closes the frozen oracle gap. No parameter tuning before classification and one factor per follow-up. (4) after a retained accuracy change, add JMH and Scala.js performance guardrails and run the frozen external same-affine court on at least five labeled pairs plus sub18. Labels and moving masks remain evaluation-only; ANTs remains an engineering oracle; promotion requires topology, export, CC, and validator-backed receipt gates.
